description_en: Queries alert events that are triggered by the same rule or of the same alert type
description_zh: 对相同规则或类型触发的告警进行归并查询
name: DescribeSimilarSecurityEvents

parameters.help_en: The source IP address of the request
parameters.name: source_ip

parameters.help_en:
The language of the content within the request and response. Default value: zh. Valid values:

zh: Chinese
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
设置请求和接收消息的语言类型，默认为zh。取值：

zh：中文
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The task ID. You can call the [CreateSimilarSecurityEventsQueryTask](~~CreateSimilarSecurityEventsQueryTask~~) operation to obtain the task ID
parameters.help_zh: 查询任务的ID。您可以调用[CreateSimilarSecurityEventsQueryTask](~~CreateSimilarSecurityEventsQueryTask~~)接口获取该参数
parameters.name: task_id

parameters.help_en: The number of the page to return. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 设置从返回结果的第几页开始显示查询结果。默认值为1，表示从第1页开始显示
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 设置分页查询时，每页显示的告警事件的数量。默认值为20，表示每页显示20条告警事件
parameters.name: page_size

PageInfo.description_zh: 查询结果页面显示的信息

Count.description_en: The number of entries returned on the current page
Count.description_zh: 分页查询时，当前页显示的数据总数量

CurrentPage.description_en: The page number of the returned page
CurrentPage.description_zh: 分页查询时，当前页的页码

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries returned per page. Default value: 20
PageSize.description_zh: 分页查询时，每页显示的告警事件的数量。默认值为20，表示每页显示20条告警事件

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned
TotalCount.description_zh: 查询到的告警事件的总数量

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request, which is used to locate and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题

SecurityEventsResponse.description_en: The information about the alert events that are triggered by the same rule or of the same alert type
SecurityEventsResponse.description_zh: 相同告警事件的列表信息

EventName.description_en: The name of the alert event

EventType.description_en:

Suspicious Process
Webshell
Unusual Logon
Malicious Software
Sensitive File Tampering
Unusual Network Connection
Other

Cloud threat detection
Precision defense
Application Whitelist
Persistence
Web Application Threat Detection
Malicious scripts
Malicious Network Activity
K8s Abnormal Behavior
Website backdoor (local engine)
Exploit
Image Scan
Trusted exception
